notes.subject: תחגרנה
notes.rationale: 'Putim rop long bel' — Hebrew idiom 'gird with joy', hills personified as wearing joy like a belt.

notes.subject: wara
notes.rationale: Hebrew ירעפו 'drip' implies water; Tok Pisin needs the object supplied.

notes.subject: רעף/גיל
notes.rationale: Verse pairs dripping abundance with shouted joy; sound-play of נאות/גבעות pastures/hills lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Ol pas bilong wailbus i dropim ⟨wara⟩; na ol smol hil i putim ⟨rop⟩ bilong amamas long bel bilong ol.
